faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by RKS Khanvel Sub District Hospital for various positions on a short-term contract basis in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for various posts including IT Engineer, Accountant, Floor Manager / Sanitary Inspector, Staff Nurse, and MIS Executive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form is 09 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RKS Khanvel Sub District Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Eligible candidates need to download the application form, fill it, attach necessary documents, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under this recruitment notification is not exceeding 35 years, with age relaxations as applicable per standard norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for IT Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the IT Engineer post must hold a B.E., B.Tech, or B.Sc degree in Information Technology from a recognized university along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Staff Nurse post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹20,000/- as specified in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the categories applying to the RKS Khanvel Sub District Hospital positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the announced posts comprises application screening followed by an interview for shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with attested photocopies of documents should be sent to the Office of the Member Secretary (RKS), Sub District Hospital, Khanvel-396230.
